opportunities.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Course
opportunities.description: A five-chapter course on the theory, SDKs and practice of the Model Context Protocol. A fundamentals certificate follows Unit 1, and a certificate of completion is awarded after the use case units.
opportunities.audience: Developers with basic AI and Python or TypeScript knowledge

opportunities.title: AWS free digital training and microcredentials
opportunities.description: Over 900 free self-paced digital courses covering AWS services at every level. Microcredentials validate hands-on skills through assessments in live AWS environments, with no subscription required.

opportunities.title: Anthropic Academy: Claude courses with completion certificates
opportunities.description: Self-paced courses on Claude, the API, Model Context Protocol, agent skills, subagents and AI fluency for several audiences. The page states that completion certificates are provided.

opportunities.title: GitHub Copilot Fundamentals (Part 1 of 2) learning path
opportunities.description: A nine-module path covering responsible AI, prompt engineering, Copilot Spaces, working across environments and unit testing with Copilot. Completing the training is free; the related certification exam is paid.

opportunities.title: Introduction to Generative AI (with badge)
opportunities.description: A 45-minute introductory microlearning course on generative AI concepts and the Google tools for building with it. The page offers a badge on completion.

opportunities.title: AI Agents Course (fundamentals and completion certificates)
opportunities.description: A hands-on course on building AI agents with no deadline for certification. A fundamentals certificate requires Unit 1, and a completion certificate also requires a use case assignment and the final challenge.

opportunities.title: Deep Learning Institute self-paced courses
opportunities.description: Many beginner self-paced courses are offered free and can be completed in a day or less. A certificate of competency is available on select courses.

watchlist.note: Replaces AI-900. The exam is paid and the page lists no free learning paths this week; a practice assessment is available after signing in to AI Skills Navigator
